units.source_text: 我施展照片的策略，确实探知了老师很我之后，眼看着我的学业就荒疏了。

en.t: After I used the strategy with the photograph and confirmed that the teacher hated me, my studies visibly fell into neglect.

units.source_text: 预料一年级的成绩是：为首的华语、历史均是84分，总分是748分，名次是84人中排列第24名。

en.t: My first-year grades were as expected: Chinese and history, my strongest subjects, were both 84 points; my total score was 748, and I ranked twenty-fourth out of eighty-four students.

units.source_text: 总课时是464小时，缺课仅14小时而已。

en.t: The total class hours were 464, and I had missed only 14 hours.

units.source_text: 预科二年级的成绩总分是693分，名次落到77人中的第35名。

en.t: In the second year of the preparatory course, my total score was 693, and my rank dropped to thirty-fifth out of seventy-seven students.

units.source_text: 我不是有钱去消磨时间，只是不愿意上课，

en.t: It was not that I had money to spend idling away my time; I simply did not want to attend classes,

units.source_text: 以闲暇为乐而逃学的，是在上三年级之后，在这新学期恰恰发生照片事件之后不久开始的。

en.t: and my habit of skipping school for the pleasure of idleness began after I entered the third year, not long after the photograph incident occurred at the start of the new term.
